title: C.Tod tells a story of struggle emotion with new single “Bad Intentions”
htmlContent: C.Tod's new single, "Bad Intentions," tells a powerful story of struggle and genuine feelings that resonate deeply with listeners. The African influence is clear, but C.Tod adds his own twist, making it unique. His heartfelt and strong singing creates a perfect mix of sadness and strength. "Bad Intentions" reflects our challenges, whether from the outside world or our own battles. C.Tod describes these struggles vividly, making them relatable to everyone. Instead of focusing solely on pain, the song pulses with hope and determination, giving it an uplifting energy. https://open.spotify.com/track/7xP2yx2wRGa0Vcb6Usar6l?si=sjJmfSf0QZaHnqhymvLMaw If it's the storytelling, the infectious African-inspired sound, or the emotion in C.Tod's voice that pulls you in, "Bad Intentions" is a track for everyone. It reminds us that music is about how it makes us feel, and C.Tod delivers that feeling powerfully. Follow on: Facebook/Instagram/TikTok
